name: Presentations.AI
desc: Deck generator that pulls brand colours from your site.
desc_zh: 能从你公司网站提取品牌配色的 PPT 生成器。
solves: Deck colours never match the brand, and a template falls apart the moment you edit it. Presentations.AI pulls colours from your site and exports an editable pptx.
solves_zh: PPT 配色总不吻合品牌，套模板一改就散。它从你的网站抓品牌色，导出的 pptx 还能再改。
best_for: A deck that has to match the company brand, not a blank page.
best_for_zh: 要交一份符合公司品牌的演示稿，而不是从空白页开始。
notes: Set the bar on brand sync and on templates that survive editing — the two things decks get rejected for at work. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.presentations.ai/zh/ai-presentation-maker
